ns2:course.label: Theatrical CAD Drafting II
ns2:course.description: Extensive knowledge of various drafting software programs is a valuable skill is becoming a more commonplace tool in Entertainment technical design and mechanics. Knowledge of the software available is a valuable asset to any student who wishes to pursue a career within the commercial side of the industry. This course will extend and enhance student skills and mastery of CAD techniques. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: THEA 419. Restricted to Theatre majors or by consent of instructor.
